sqlquery.from:
( select mu.id, cas.name as cacName, cas.email as cacEmail, cas.phone as cacPhone, cas.fax as cacFax, cas.website as cacWebsite, cas.number as cacNumber, cas.accountTypesName as accountTypesName, numberOfEmployees.name as numberOfEmployeesName, annualRevenue.name as annualRevenueName, (mu.firstName||' '||mu.lastname) as mufirstLastName, st2.name as st2Name, st3.name as st3Name, st4.name as st4Name, billingAddress.address as billingAddressAddress, mailingAddress.address as mailingAddressAddress, billingAddress.city as billingAddressCity, mailingAddress.city as mailingAddressCity, co.name as coName, co2.name as co2Name, billingAddress.zipcode as billingAddressZipcode, mailingAddress.zipcode as mailingAddressZipcode
from (select cac.number, array_to_string(array_agg(accountTypes.name), ', ') as accountTypesName, cac.website, cac.name, cac.email, cac.phone, cac.fax, cac.annualRevenueId, cac.numberOfEmployeesId, cac.ownership, cac.industry, cac.billingaddressid, cac.mailingaddressid, cac.rating,cac.owner from "$".crmaccount cac left join "$".crmaccount_types types on types.crmaccount_id = cac.id left join "$".reference accountTypes on accountTypes.id = types.type_id where cac.deleted is not true group by cac.number, cac.name, cac.website, cac.email, cac.phone, cac.fax, cac.annualRevenueId, cac.numberOfEmployeesId,cac.ownership,cac.industry,cac.billingaddressid,cac.mailingaddressid,cac.rating,cac.owner ) cas left join "$".myuser mu on cas.owner = mu.id left join "$".reference annualRevenue on annualRevenue.id = cas.annualRevenueId left join "$".reference numberOfEmployees on numberOfEmployees.id = cas.numberOfEmployeesId left join "$".reference st2 on st2.id = cas.ownership left join "$".reference st3 on st3.id = cas.industry left join "$".reference st4 on st4.id = cas.rating left join "$".address billingAddress on billingAddress.id = cas.billingaddressid left join "$".address mailingAddress on mailingAddress.id = cas.mailingaddressid left join "public".country co on co.id = billingAddress.countryid left join "public".country co2 on co2.id = mailingAddress.countryid ) t
